name: 60097 · Wonder Lake, IL
findings: ZIP 60097 (Wonder Lake) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60097 (Wonder Lake) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 60097 (Wonder Lake) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 55% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.
